heading: Frequently Asked Questions
desc: Let's find the answers to your questions.
a_why_vpnhood: VpnHood is powered by the VpnHood! ENGINE, developed by the VpnHood team. It combines open-source client and server code, flexible split tunneling and Cloak Mode, which is designed to help VPN traffic blend into ordinary encrypted browsing. VpnHood! CONNECT offers unlimited free traffic without account registration on Android and Android TV.
a_is_vpnhood_free: Yes, VpnHood offers a free VPN service without any time, traffic, or bandwidth limitations. However, you can unlock additional features by upgrading to a premium subscription. With the premium plan, you gain access to servers in more countries, faster connection speeds, and enhanced app functionality. For further information, visit the plan details page.
a_connect_vs_client: VpnHood! CONNECT is a free VPN that users can enjoy without limitations. However, while VpnHood! CLIENT is also free, it does not include servers for direct connections. It connects to a VpnHood! server that you, or someone you trust, already runs, using an access key they give you.
a_supported_platforms: VpnHood! CLIENT runs on Android, iOS (iPhone and iPad), Android TV, Windows, and Linux. VpnHood! CONNECT runs on Android, iOS (iPhone and iPad), Android TV, Windows, and Linux. On iOS, Windows and Linux, VpnHood! CONNECT has no free servers; you'll need to purchase a Premium Key, which is available on the pricing page.
a_is_open_source: Yes, all of it. VpnHood! CONNECT, VpnHood! CLIENT, the server, and the VpnHood! ENGINE behind them are published on GitHub, and the project has been audited by two independent security firms. You can read the code yourself rather than take our word for it.
a_is_undetectable: VpnHood's Cloak Mode is designed to make VPN traffic resemble ordinary HTTPS traffic, helping it avoid some VPN-detection methods. This does not guarantee that every network will allow the connection; effectiveness depends on the filtering methods in use.
